messages:
jen: Heads-up — quick agenda swap for today's all-hands. We need to move roadmap Q&A to after infra updates because of a late deploy. Recording will start in ~5m; if you need slides, drop them now. @carmen @alex

carmen: Thanks! Noted. Can we get a backup recorder ready? OBS hiccup last time.

noah: I'll stand up a temp recorder VM and stream a copy to S3 as redundancy. rclone + ffmpeg. Command below:

```
ffmpeg -f x11grab -r 30 -s 1280x720 -i :0.0 -c:v libx264 -preset veryfast -b:v 2500k -f flv rtmp://ingest.internal/allhands
rclone copy /var/recordings s3:allhands-backups/$(date +%F)_$(date +%s).mp4
```

sam: @noah awesome. Can you share obs profile name? we need mic mapping.

noah: obs profile: allhands-fallback. Mic mapping is 'TeamMic -> Mic 1', 'Backup -> Mic 2'. I'll attach the config in #eng-infra after the meeting.

maria: I'll handle slide handoff. Please drop final slides in this thread or @maria-direct so I can queue.

alex: Roadmap Q&A moved to slot after infra updates — still allocating 15m. If you have product questions, drop them here and we'll try to triage live.

jen: Please follow clip guidelines: short clips only, tag with timestamp and speaker. Example: '00:12:34 - Carmen - roadmap hot take'. I'll collect and push to comms.

carmen: Quick leadership note — we'll highlight prioritization around latency/cost wins. Save detailed pricing Qs for office hours.

deploy-bot: Deployment finished: service-inference v2.4.1 -> prod (CI 1024) :white_check_mark:

sam: Noticed one presenter Zoom feed is lagging on the encoder. If it persists switch to local camera input.

jen: On that — if anyone needs to swap out, wave on camera or ping @jen. Also, captions are enabled; if you see issues say 'cc captions' in this thread.

maria: Final slides uploaded: https://drive.company/allhands/2026-03-23/slide-deck-v3.pdf

alex: I'll answer top product Qs live. Two asks already: embedding pricing and dedicated capacity latency SLOs.

jen: Action items: 1) @noah setup backup stream to S3 (done pre-meeting). 2) @maria collect slides (done). 3) @carmen prep 2-min roadmap highlight. 4) Clips: drop requests here. I'll send post-meeting recap with timestamps.

carmen: thanks everyone. Let's start in ~3m. :rocket:

jen: starting recording now — live stream health: 100% | backup upload queued. :white_check_mark:
